title: Labor Department suspends enforcement of 2024 H-2A farmworker rule
description_short: On June 20, 2025, the Labor Department suspended enforcement of all provisions introduced by the 2024 H-2A Farmworker Protection Rule.
description_medium: On June 20, 2025, the Labor Department’s Wage and Hour Division announced that it would stop enforcing all provisions introduced by the 2024 H-2A Farmworker Protection Rule, effective immediately. The Department cited court injunctions and said litigation continued while it considered further regulatory action. The guidance left pre-2024 H-2A requirements enforceable and did not change existing regulations.
description_long: On June 20, 2025, the Department of Labor’s Wage and Hour Division announced a nationwide suspension of enforcement for all provisions introduced in the 2024 H-2A Farmworker Protection Rule. Field Assistance Bulletin 2025-2 directed staff to stop enforcing that rule and to assess employer compliance under the regulations in effect on June 27, 2024; the bulletin made the suspension effective immediately. The Department said court injunctions had already interrupted implementation and created legal uncertainty and operational challenges for farmers using the H-2A program. It said litigation continued while it considered further regulatory action. The 2024 rule covered the H-2A temporary agricultural labor certification program and included protections for foreign farmworkers, including workplace-organizing protections. DOL described its June guidance as an enforcement policy: it did not change existing regulations, create legally enforceable obligations, or limit the agency’s authority to enforce H-2A requirements that predated the 2024 rule.

supported_facts: The June 20, 2025 Field Assistance Bulletin directs immediate suspension of enforcement for all provisions and application of June 27, 2024 regulations.

quotes.quote: U.S Department of Labor Wage and Hour Division
Effective immediately, WHD will suspend enforcement of all provisions introduced in the 2024 H-2A Final Rule.

A temporary, nationwide suspension of enforcement ensures clarity and consistency while existing litigation over the legality of the 2024 Final Rule continues, and the Department considers further regulatory action.
Apply the version of 20 CFR part 655, subpart B, and 29 CFR part 501 in effect on June 27, 2024, for purposes of assessing employer compliance
This enforcement policy is intended to provide clarity and consistency for WHD staff while that process is underway.

This FAB is intended solely as internal guidance for Department personnel, and as a notice to the public of WHD’s enforcement position. It does not create any legally enforceable rights or obligations and does not alter any statutory or regulatory requirements.

limitations: This is a DOL-authored Field Assistance Bulletin reproduced on a Penn State Ag Law host, not a DOL-hosted URL.
